content.contents: some of you may not know of this. it's a collab i released with drexgod. we used this as the cover. i was proud of this drawing, sent it to him the day after i drew it and he said he really liked it which was sweet.

i was stoned as hell listening to Stone In Focus by Aphex Twin and i drew this looking at a zero-caffeine diet coke. there's the answer to all of you who felt flummoxed seeing these cans for sale in your local supermarket; i am the kind of bitch who buys caffeine-free diet coke. mainly because if i have any caffeine past 7-8pm i can't sleep. but i love diet coke so much that i can't help but wish for a sweet sip in the evenings. hence, my girlfriend and i purchase these on a semi-regular basis. here's the full artwork:
